verdict.rationale: Raygun docs confirm 'smart filters' to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags (raygun-docs-3), and a search results page with error-chart visualization (raygun-docs-19), showing real filtering/search capability. However, there is no evidence of a documented query syntax, explicit cross-project search, or release/environment as first-class filter dimensions. Missing for 10: documented query language/syntax, explicit cross-project search support, release/environment filter examples, and independent corroboration of filter depth.
